trip: In-window 13–19 Oct 2026 plus evergreen activities near Qawra

items.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals (the reason you're here)
items.address: BLAST Arena Studios, Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta' Qali, ATD 4000
items.hours: Wed 14 – Sun 18 Oct 2026 (doors/match times per daily email from the organiser)
items.description: Five-day CS2 LAN finals, 8 teams, $1M prize pool. Two double-elim groups into single-elim playoffs; Bo3 all matches, Bo5 final. Broadcast crew: SPUNJ, Machine, Hugo Byron, JustHarry (casters), stunna & Tech Girl (desk).
items.notes: PR Newswire (organiser release) + HLTV 16 Sep 2026. Teams per HLTV/team-list release: FURIA (defending), Falcons + 6 more (see event.html). Format per HLTV.

items.name: Rolex Middle Sea Race — start (47th edition)
items.address: Start line between the Saluting Battery and Fort St Angelo; free viewing from Upper Barrakka Gardens
items.hours: Sat 17 Oct 2026, late morning (exact gun time TBC)
items.description: The 606nm offshore classic starts in Grand Harbour on the playoff Saturday — one of the world's great yacht-race starts, watchable free from Upper Barrakka.
items.notes: Date confirmed across ManicMalta's Oct-2026 calendar and Gozo Highspeed's race notice (restricted sailings 14 & 17 Oct). Exact start hour not yet published — RMYC programme T-7. Conflicts with a playoff day at the venue.

items.name: In Guardia — military re-enactment
items.hours: Sundays — 18 Oct 2026 falls in the trip window (also 25 Oct)
items.description: Historic re-enactment of a 16th-century garrison muster at Fort St Elmo — scheduled Sundays; the Sunday 18 Oct edition lands inside the trip window.
items.notes: Listing via ManicMalta (Sundays 18 & 25 Oct). Confirm session time with Heritage Malta before going.

items.name: Mediterranea Festival, Gozo
items.price_range: Mixed — some events free, concerts ticketed
items.description: Gozo's autumn arts festival opening from 15 Oct — heritage, music and arts around the Citadel. Combine with a Gozo day trip on the Buġibba fast ferry.
items.notes: Programme detail TBC — festival schedule pages publish closer to the date.

items.name: BirguFest / Birgu by Candlelight
items.hours: DATE CONFLICT: 9–10 Oct 2026 (two guides) vs 16–17 Oct 2026 (one guide, 'preliminary')
items.description: Vittoriosa lit by tens of thousands of candles with music, re-enactments and open historic buildings. If the 16–17 Oct date is correct it falls in your window; if 9–10 Oct is correct it happens before you arrive.
items.notes: CONFLICT unresolved: hubpymalta + ManicMalta say 9–10 Oct; beautifulmalta.com says 'preliminary 16–17 Oct'. No organiser page found. DO NOT plan around this — verify with the Birgu Local Council or birgu-fest.com. Logged in OPEN_QUESTIONS.

items.name: La Traviata — Teatru Aurora, Gozo
items.description: Verdi's La Traviata at one of Gozo's two grand opera houses — the Saturday-evening cultural option if you skip the Middle Sea Race start.
items.notes: Listing via ManicMalta's Oct-2026 calendar; confirm and book at Teatru Aurora's own box office.

items.name: The Gamers Lounge (LAN café & shop)
items.price_range: Timed PC sessions (rate not published online — ask in-store)
items.description: Malta's best-known gaming venue since 2015: high-end PC stations on GO fibre, esports chairs, Red Bull, plus a hardware shop (monitors, peripherals, full PC builds). Reddit's standard answer to 'internet café in Malta'.
items.notes: Session rates remain unpublished on the site (checked 9 Oct 2026) — logged in OPEN_QUESTIONS. Reachable from Qawra via 212/TD13 to Sliema side + short hop, or 45 to Valletta + change.

items.name: Esports Plaza Gaming Lounge
items.address: Level 0, The Plaza Shopping Centre, Bisazza Street, Sliema SLM 1640
items.description: Modern internet-café/gaming lounge inside The Plaza mall, Sliema — PCs for casual and competitive play; the Sliema-side alternative to Gamers Lounge.
items.notes: Listing via hopsa.io directory; verify opening hours on site. Reachable via the 212 along the coast.

items.name: Forbidden Power (tabletop & card games)
items.description: Tabletop/TCG shop and play space named on r/malta for card games — the change-of-pace from digital gaming.
items.notes: Named in a 2018 Reddit thread only — no current official page located. Verify it still exists before making the trip. UNVERIFIED.

items.name: Diving & snorkelling (Qawra point and north coast)
items.address: Qawra Point; operator bases around St Paul's Bay &Ċirkewwa
items.hours: Daytime; October = peak visibility season per local dive media
items.description: October has the year's best underwater visibility and still-warm sea (22–24°C). Qawra Point is the walk-in snorkel option from the hotel; certified dives run from the north-coast bases.
items.notes: Price bands are guide estimates, not quotes. Malta National Aquarium's Qawra page also highlights snorkelling/scuba at Qawra.

items.name: Popeye Village (Anchor Bay)
items.description: The 1980 film-set village of Popeye, now an open-air fun park with boat rides and shows — one of the classic north-Malta outings, ~20 min by car/taxi from Qawra.
items.notes: Entry price is a guide figure. No direct bus — Bolt/taxi or rental car; combine with Golden Bay/Għajn Tuffieħa.

items.name: Golden Bay & Għajn Tuffieħa Bay
items.address: Golden Bay bus terminus (route 223 from Buġibba)
items.description: Malta's best sandy beaches on the north-west coast — reachable on bus 223 from Buġibba (~25 min). October swimming with warm seas and thin crowds is the local secret.
items.notes: Route 223 (Buġibba–Għajn Tuffieħa–Golden Bay) from the atlas index. Beach quality per VisitMalta/standard guides.

items.name: Comino & Blue Lagoon boat trips
items.address: Departures from Buġibba/Qawra jetties and Ċirkewwa (operators vary)
items.price_range: Unpriced this session — no official operator page found
items.description: Boat trips to the Blue Lagoon and Comino's caves — numerous small operators run from the north coast in season; Gozo Highspeed's 'Golden Comino Escape' bundle exists on the Explore Flex card (€53–59).
items.notes: Individual operator prices remain unverified (logged in OPEN_QUESTIONS for multiple sessions). The Explore Flex bundle price IS verified (official fares page) — compare before booking a random jetty tout.

items.name: Core landmark day-trips (Valletta, Mdina, temples, Three Cities)
items.address: See landmarks.html for the full plan
items.description: Valletta (St John's €15, Fort St Elmo €10, Grand Master's Palace €12), Mdina silent city, Ħaġar Qim & Mnajdra €10, Hypogeum Ħal Saflieni €35 (book ahead — 10 per tour), Blue Grotto boats, Dingli cliffs, Three Cities.
items.notes: Prices from Heritage Malta official pages (re-verified 24 Sep 2026 pass). The Malta Maritime Museum is closed; St John's closed Sundays (opens 11:00 Thu 15 Oct).
